hyperedges.label: KCI Sync Pipeline (ScheduleSyncService -> KciService -> KciClient impls)

nodes.label: KciClient interface
nodes.rationale: To connect another source implement App\Services\Kci\Contracts\KciClient and bind in AppServiceProvider

nodes.label: MockKciClient
nodes.rationale: Deterministic generated timetable (5 lines, ~70 stations); times are not official

nodes.label: ScheduleSyncService
nodes.rationale: Upserts and writes sync logs; pages and API never call KCI directly, they read PostgreSQL

nodes.label: Custom Domains via Caddy Reverse Proxy
nodes.norm_label: custom domains via caddy reverse proxy
nodes.rationale: my-krl.local / api.my-krl.local with tls internal; SESSION_DOMAIN shares cookies across subdomains; TRUSTED_PROXIES so URLs use https

nodes.label: KCI Schedule Sync (kci:sync-schedules)
nodes.rationale: Daily; cache lock prevents concurrent syncs; upsert on (station_id, service_date, train_number); per-station failures yield partial; upstream timetable undated so stored for today only

nodes.label: KCI Station Sync (kci:sync-stations)
nodes.rationale: Monthly; is_active and coordinates belong to admin and are never overwritten; missing stations reported not deleted

nodes.label: KCI Train Stops Fetch
nodes.rationale: Parallel batches (concurrency 5) due to 3-7s per request; rate-limit aware (429 Retry-After); skips already-stored trains

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 17 Database
nodes.rationale: Redis is not used: sessions, cache, locks and the queue use the database

nodes.label: Next.js agent rules (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data

nodes.label: KRL Schedule Indonesia
nodes.rationale: Laravel REST API + Next.js + PostgreSQL schedule app for KRL Commuter Line Jabodetabek

nodes.label: Sanctum SPA Cookie Authentication
nodes.rationale: No token stored in localStorage; only HTTP-only cookies plus XSRF double-submit; remember-me by default so users stay signed in

nodes.label: Admin-overridable API URLs (settings table)
nodes.rationale: Admins can change/test/reset Stations, Schedules, Train Stops API URLs; stored in settings table overriding .env

nodes.label: Versioned API /api/v1
nodes.rationale: Supports cookie sessions (browser) and bearer tokens (mobile/Flutter) so a mobile app can reuse the same backend

nodes.label: Admin Session Guard
nodes.rationale: Separate admin guard: website login never grants admin; role re-checked in DB each request so demotion is immediate; not remembered
